description: Represents a display / standalone mathematical equation as ONE equation block whose content is its LaTeX.
applicability: The region is a standalone / display equation or formula (often set off on its own line, sometimes numbered).
The OCR renders math as LaTeX between $$...$$ or inside <math>...</math>.
instructions: Emit each display equation as ONE block of block_type equation. Its content is the equation's LaTeX kept VERBATIM (preserve the $$...$$ / <math> LaTeX the OCR produced; do not paraphrase math into words).
Do NOT merge a display equation into the surrounding paragraph; keep inline math inside its paragraph, but a set-off / numbered equation is its own equation block.
If the equation carries an equation number, keep the number with the equation.
Never transcribe an equation as a table and never drop it.

provenance.reason: General-document adaptation (MPDocBench): academic/exam documents contain display equations scored on their LaTeX.
